findings.summary: Source ledger keys and artifact lookup are not tenant-scoped
findings.details: The task requires stable tenant keys and rejection of missing/cross-org bindings. The implementation accepts any non-empty organizationKey, derives source identity without organizationKey, and exposes a channel/provider-object artifact index without organizationKey. A future capture/read path using these contract keys can collide or select artifacts across tenants or connections that reuse provider channel/object identifiers.

findings.summary: Receipt dedupe and source keys omit connection generation fencing
findings.details: The task design makes connectionGeneration part of transport receipt identity and stale-generation fencing. The validator and receipt index dedupe only by connectionKey and transportDeliveryId, and sourceKey also omits generation. A stale transport delivery from an old connection generation can be treated as a duplicate of a current delivery or share source identity with a later generation, breaking replay/idempotency and revision fencing.
